summary: A beginner moved 155.5 USDT on TRC20 from a Binance Exchange account to a wallet and then could not transfer or swap the funds because the wallet contained no TRX for network fees.
user_mistake: moved TRC20 USDT to a wallet without retaining TRX for network fees
prevention: Keep enough TRX available before moving or exchanging USDT on the TRON network
